The cleanest US-listed reference exposures are diversified electrical-equipment leaders, while the underfollowed lane is stronger in adjacent equipment: custom electrical distribution systems, power protection, magnetics, switchgear, and critical-power packages. Hammond Power Solutions remains a strong node reference but is not treated as a core US-listed candidate in this pass because its primary listing is Canadian and US exposure is OTC-style rather than a main US exchange listing. Reference lane is anchored by broad electrical leaders with explicit transformer, switchgear, data-center, utility, and backlog evidence.
